name: dev-cir
comment: Dev project 'CIR: узи омт'. Chosen because it is NOT a fixture of the parallel search_materials measurement, so it can be backfilled without destroying anyone's test objects. Russian technical corpus with a deep heading tree (extractor guide, УЗИ protocol instructions, benchmark run) plus 40 memory facts — so it also exercises the fact-level ranking. `expect` matches the parent title case-insensitively as a substring.

queries.why: Verbatim model id. Sanity floor — a miss means the index is broken, not imprecise.
Verbatim identifier inside a fenced YAML block — the construct the naive heading regex mis-handles.
Verbatim config keys that exist as headings AND in body prose.

queries.query: что проверить перед тем как править настройки извлечения
queries.why: Restates '## Контрольный список перед изменением конфига' without its words (контрольный/список/конфиг).
Restates '### Характерные ошибки транскрибации аудио' in a user's own words.

queries.query: насколько точно модель совпала с эталоном
queries.why: The document states a score (1238/1260); the query never uses its vocabulary (расхождения/промахов).
Broad 'where is anything about X'. Competes with template/bufer, which are also about the protocol — the class a summary level would serve.
Deliberately vague; expected weak before the summary level exists.

Answer lives under '## Четыре слоя ответственности — не смешивать'. The heading carries the discriminating words; the body enumerates layers without restating them — the direct probe for the breadcrumb change (D1).
Maps to '## Где смотреть в коде'; the body is a bare path list with no such phrase.
Maps to '### Фильтрация контента' — nested under the protocol prompt, needs the ANCESTOR path, not just the local heading.

queries.query: рубец на матке и кесарево сечение
queries.why: A document with NO headings at all — the control for the breadcrumb change: it must not regress when there is no heading path to prepend.
A project-memory fact must outrank raw chunks on its own subject (the fact-level ordering INVARIANT). Guards that chunker changes do not disturb the memory level.
Second fact-level probe, phrased as a question rather than a term.
